The Sacramento County Employees Retirement System (SCERS) has committed $50 million to Wolff Credit Partners IV, a closed-end, value-added strategy of The Wolff Co.

Wolff Credit Partners IV invests in multifamily debt in the United States. A fundraising goal has not been disclosed. In early 2026, The Los Angeles Fire and Police Pensions committed $75 million to this fund.

The fund’s predecessor, Wolff Credit Partners III, raised $510 million in equity.

SCERS, a public pension fund, had $15.5 billion in total assets under management, as of Sept. 30. As of then, it had an 8 percent real estate allocation target with $1.2 billion in total real estate assets.
